source_text: Non erat civitas quae faceret pacem cum filiis Israel praeter Gabaonitas — ceterae ad bellum. Pax cum Iesu non nisi per confessionem et famulatum. Gloria. Amen.
pass_a_gloss: Not was city which made peace with sons of-Israel except Gibeonites — rest unto war. Peace with Jesus not unless through confession and service. Glory. Amen.
pass_b_english: [[No city made peace with Israel except the Gibeonites; the rest went to war >> Bible:Joshua 11:19]]. Peace with Jesus comes only through confession and service. Glory. Amen.
